I need to understand two things in the Nxeon hosting-platform codebase, now live in production at /opt/nxeon on this machine (also mirrored for reference at /opt/nxeon-v2, its just-promoted source fork — same code now, essentially).

1. **The announcement/broadcast system.** There's a `UpdateAnnouncement` Prisma model and an admin page at `app/admin/announcements/page.tsx`. Read how this system actually works end to end: how an admin creates/publishes an announcement (find the admin UI form and the server action it calls), what fields it has (title, body, a "kind" field which the schema shows defaults to 'FEATURE' — what are the valid kind values? grep the type/enum), whether it targets ALL users or specific segments, and — critically — HOW a customer actually sees it (is it a dashboard banner, a modal, a notification bell item, an email? trace it all the way to the customer-facing component). Also check: does publishing one send a real email to every user, or is it purely in-app? I need to know exactly what publishing one will actually do before we use it to announce a major redesign to every real customer.

2. **The feedback/bug-report page.** A user just said "the feedback/bug report page... seems to be missing." Find out if there is ANY existing way for a customer to submit feedback or report a bug in this app — check the dashboard sidebar nav config, search for "feedback", "bug report", "report a bug", "/support" (there's likely an existing support/ticket system — check if IT could serve this purpose, e.g. a support ticket category), and any existing but perhaps unlinked page. Report definitively: does a feedback/bug-report destination exist anywhere (even if not obviously linked), or is it genuinely absent and would need to be built.

This is investigation only — do not write or change any code. Report back concisely (under 500 words) with file:line references, and be precise about the announcement system's actual delivery mechanism (in-app only vs. also emailing every customer) since that determines how carefully we test before publishing.

- Valid `kind` enum, grepped from code (not just schema comment): `lib/actions-announcements.ts:30` → `FEATURE | IMPROVEMENT | BUGFIX`.
- Admin UI: `app/admin/announcements/page.tsx` → `components/admin/AnnouncementsAdmin.tsx`, calling server actions `createAnnouncement`/`publishAnnouncement`/`unpublishAnnouncement`/`deleteAnnouncement` in `lib/actions-announcements.ts:44-116`.
- Targeting: `serviceTypes` = `["GAME","VPS","HOSTING","DOMAINS","MAIL","BILLING","PLATFORM"]` (`lib/actions-announcements.ts:25`); **empty array = shown to everyone**. `getUserServiceTypes()` (`:124-147`) derives a user's own services; `BILLING`/`PLATFORM` are unconditionally included for every account.
- **Delivery mechanism — in-app only, no email, verified by absence:** `getUnseenAnnouncements()` (`:154-173`) is queried by `components/customer/AnnouncementPopup.tsx`, a client component mounted in `app/dashboard/layout.tsx:236` — it renders a **modal popup** (blocking dialog, one at a time) on next dashboard load, plus `markAnnouncementSeen`. There's also a persistent feed at `app/dashboard/whats-new/page.tsx` via `getWhatsNew()` (`:203-235`). I grepped `lib/actions-announcements.ts` and `AnnouncementsAdmin.tsx` for `sendMail|sendEmail|resend|nodemailer|mailer` — zero matches. **Publishing does not email anyone; it only surfaces in-app to users who next open the dashboard**, filtered/instant only for logged-in sessions.

### 2. Feedback / bug-report page

**It exists — it is not missing, just weakly discoverable.** `app/dashboard/feedback/page.tsx` is a full dashboard page ("Report a bug or request a feature — and track where your ideas land"), backed by `submitFeedback()`/`db.feedback` in `lib/actions-feedback.ts:19-63`, with an admin triage view at `app/admin/feedback/page.tsx`. It's also reachable via a floating "🐞 Report a bug" bubble (`components/FeedbackWidget.tsx:94`, mounted globally at `components/portal/Shell.tsx:574`). However, the dashboard sidebar (`app/dashboard/layout.tsx:88-94`) has a comment "Support + Feedback merged" but only lists `{ label: "Support", href: "/dashboard/support" }` — there is **no sidebar nav entry linking to `/dashboard/feedback`**, and `/dashboard/support/page.tsx` has no link to it either. So the user's "seems to be missing" complaint is accurate for nav discoverability even though the page and backend are fully built and functional.
